# AFKSystem
A simple AFK system for Paper featuring player protection, kicking, placeholders and more.

## Features
- Localization
- AFK kick
- AFK protection
- Warn players before kicking them
- MiniPlaceholders and PlaceholderAPI placeholders

## Installation
See the [wiki](https://github.com/fabianmakila/afksystem/wiki/installation) for platform specific instructions.

## Placeholder support
AFKSystem provides placeholders for both [MiniPlaceholders](https://modrinth.com/plugin/miniplaceholders) and [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi).

You can find the list of available placeholders [here](https://github.com/fabianmakila/AFKSystem/wiki/Placeholders).

## Discord
Got questions or need help with the plugin? Join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/hNMvqruCuK) where you can get support or just hangout with the community.
